name: GitHub助手
author: X-Agent Team
description: GitHub API integration for X-Agent. Manage repositories, issues, and pull requests directly from X-Agent.
description_zh: GitHub API集成插件。直接在X-Agent中管理代码仓库、问题和拉取请求。
long_description: This plugin provides comprehensive GitHub integration for X-Agent, allowing you to manage your repositories, track issues, and automate pull request workflows without leaving X-Agent.
long_description_zh: 这个插件为X-Agent提供全面的GitHub集成，让你可以在X-Agent中管理仓库、跟踪问题和自动化拉取请求工作流。
